purpose: Record actual physical-device validation of the final signed iOS and Android builds. JavaScript export and browser tests do not fill this report.

checks.check: Install the intended signed build through TestFlight or an approved iOS device track and the intended Android internal/closed track; verify app name, version, build number and release identity.
Launch a fresh installation with connectivity disabled. Confirm bundled catalogue, guides and a usable local trip render without requiring a network response.
Create a synthetic trip, change date/base/transport/party, save a place, reorder an outing and edit packing. Terminate the process, relaunch offline and verify every edit remains.
Exercise one-to-seven-day and three-outing limits, full-day conflicts, season changes and car-free/base transfer warnings. Confirm blocked or adjusted actions are explained.

Add a synthetic booking with Banff date/time and a distinctive private note. Verify marked-booked wording remains a personal checklist, and a shared summary omits that private note. Use a local/private test destination.
Complete the native offline-save/export action, verify its file and success state, and test a failed write or unavailable share handler. Confirm a failure does not produce a completed-save claim.

Deny location permission and verify manual browsing works. With tester-authorised location, test Near me, unavailable/approximate coordinates and map source attribution. Verify map/directions network requirements are clear.

Verify dated fixed-station ECCC weather, expiry, denied/offline network and malformed/unavailable data. Confirm requests do not contain user GPS or trip/booking notes and no failure becomes zero or safe/open status.

Deny notification permission and verify core use continues. With tester approval, schedule a near-future synthetic booking reminder; verify real notification delivery and the selected booking destination when opened.

Verify reminder edits replace the old notification; deletion/turn-off/reset cancel it. Repeat from a device timezone outside Alberta and across America/Edmonton daylight-saving boundaries, including rejected nonexistent wall times.

Exercise park-pass and trip-budget tools with adults/children, different durations, blank/invalid/large inputs and restored state. Verify dated rates, separate transport/parking/admission and clear estimates.

Use VoiceOver/TalkBack, large text, reduced motion, keyboard dismissal, screen-edge safe areas and landscape/tablet handling where supported. Verify selected tabs and checked checklist items announce their actual states.
Open official-source, guide, map and booking links, then return to the app without lost state. Verify no test booking, payment or conversion is submitted.

On a disposable synthetic trip, verify reset removes saved trip data and reminders. Test upgrading a previous test build with valid and corrupted stored data; confirm clear recovery and no silent loss of unrelated device data.
Verify app privacy controls, production /app/privacy/ and /app/support/ URLs, monitored contact, actual SDK/network disclosures and consistency with store privacy/Data safety forms.

releaseDecision.notes: All checks are unexecuted. Populate results only from the identified final signed builds on real devices.
